overview: Global climate talks face deadlocks over fossil fuels while international conflicts and major security developments unfold. Commercial real estate industry participants note that the sector is better positioned to withstand future interest rate hikes compared to past market dislocations. San Francisco officials and residents prepare for severe storms and heavy rain ahead of the Thanksgiving holiday, while the city's supervisors eye moving the downtown courthouse. Meanwhile, major developments in Hawaii include a fuel spill threatening Oahu's coastline and a fresh path for the Thirty Meter Telescope following a university regents' vote.

items.title: Fight over fossil fuels leaves COP31 climate talks in deadlock
items.summary: Delegates from nearly 200 countries are stuck in a deadlock at COP31 climate talks over the future of fossil fuels.

items.title: Russia-bound ship attacked in Gulf of Finland
items.summary: Finnish defense forces stated that Ukraine was likely behind a drone attack targeting a Russia-bound ship in the Gulf of Finland.

items.title: Top Drug Kingpin Is Captured by Mexican Army as Gunfire Erupts
items.summary: The Mexican army captured Fausto Isidro Meza Flores, a top drug kingpin and one of the FBI's most wanted fugitives, during an operation that sparked regional gunfire.

items.title: Killer robots: U.N. talks fall short of hopes for legally binding rules
items.summary: United Nations talks in Geneva failed to establish legally binding rules on autonomous weapons as military artificial intelligence advances.

items.title: CRE Positioned to Withstand 2022 Repeat Amid Rising Rates: NYU Schack Panelists
items.summary: Debt investors at an NYU Schack panel indicated that commercial real estate is better equipped today to avoid the market dislocation seen in 2022.

items.title: Mall of Justice? Supes eye moving courthouse downtown
items.summary: San Francisco supervisors are exploring the possibility of moving the downtown courthouse after the Hall of Justice was deemed seismically unsound.

items.title: Inside San Francisco’s great flood, and why next week may be even worse
items.summary: A UC Berkeley expert explains the recent flooding in San Francisco and warns that upcoming storms could worsen conditions ahead of Thanksgiving.

items.title: Experts: Fuel Spill Could Swiftly Reach Oʻahu’s Fragile Coast
items.summary: Experts warn that a fuel spill has already spread to a sanctuary for endangered native plants and could swiftly reach Oahu's coastline.

items.title: Thirty Meter Telescope Gets New Life With Hawaiʻi Regents’ Vote
items.summary: The Thirty Meter Telescope received a new path forward following a vote by Hawaii regents, though funding hurdles and potential protests remain.

wiki.title: Talking to Yourself
wiki.extract: "Talking to Yourself" is a song by Carly Rae Jepsen from her sixth studio album, The Loneliest Time (2022). Jepsen wrote it with songwriter Simon Wilcox and its producers, Benjamin Berger and Ryan Rabin from the production team Captain Cuts. School Boy and Interscope Records released it as the album's third single on September 16, 2022. "Talking to Yourself" is a dance-pop and synth-pop song, in which Jepsen recalls a relationship with an ex-lover and wonders if he still has feelings for her.

otd.text: The Belgian government imposed a four-day security lockdown in Brussels based on information about potential terrorist attacks.
A remote-controlled bomb exploded on a bus in Tel Aviv, Israel, injuring at least 28 people on board.
